label: Ted
description: A wisecracking Boston teddy bear who can't reach the pedals.
direction: Speak in a blunt, nasal, working-class Boston accent: fast, cheeky and deadpan, a wise guy who happens to be a teddy bear. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Ted is an adult-comedy character; this pack keeps the Boston attitude and the thunder buddies and drops everything crude. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Universal Pictures / Media Rights Capital (character created by Seth MacFarlane)
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and character are in copyright and trademarked. Seth MacFarlane created the character and performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Seth MacFarlane's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Whatever that is.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Who measures like this?
lines.start_drive_1: Hey, Johnny! Let's go for a ride, buddy.
lines.start_drive_2: Thunder buddies for life! Now start the car.
lines.start_drive_3: All right, I'm a teddy bear giving directions. Just go with it.
lines.start_drive_4: What's up, pal? Road trip. Wicked.
lines.start_drive_5: Buckle me in, would ya? I'm 'bout two feet tall.
lines.start_drive_6: Come on, come on, let's go, I ain't got all day.
lines.start_drive_7: I wished for a driver, and I got you. Eh. Good enough.
lines.start_drive_8: Wicked awesome. We're goin' for a drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Relax, I know Boston like the back of my paw.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Nice goin', Johnny.
lines.arrived: We're here! Not bad for a stuffed bear, huh?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Seven exits? Come on!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Aw, come on! Classic Boston.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wasn't me. I can't reach the pedals.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Unless it's thunder, we're fine. Careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I ain't payin' that.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop the car, pal.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. I'm just a regular teddy bear.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it! Don't worry, thunder buddy, I got this.
